title: Triplets on the fingerboard
description: Two 3:2 eighth triplets and a 3:2 QUARTER triplet on a guitar part in staffKind both, every note carrying its string and fret. The tab staff draws no beams, so a bracket is the only thing that can say where a group begins and ends — and the standalone tab view draws one where the combined view does not, because there the notation staff above already carries it. The quarter triplet is the case a converter or renderer that assumes tuplets are always eighths gets wrong: its three notes span a half note, and its columns are wider than the eighths above them.
